reason: I already track everything in my Google Sheet and it works, so I don't see why I'd pay to move to something new. I'd maybe use the free 14 days to see if the slip and statement features are actually faster, but I'd probably drop it once the trial ends.
objection: Free budget apps already do this, and I don't want to rebuild my spreadsheet somewhere else just to save a bit of typing.
would_change_my_mind: If the trial showed that the statement import and slip capture cut my monthly entry time to almost nothing, with accurate categories and no fiddling.
